settings.text: A creamy stick that melts into a sheer flush and builds to a deep stain. Satin finish, fragrance-free, and soft enough to use on cheeks and lips alike. Vegan and cruelty-free.

settings.label: Ingredients
settings.text: A peptide complex, plant squalane, vitamin E and shea butter in a cushiony base, with mineral pigments for color. No fragrance, no gluten.

settings.label: How to use
settings.text: Swipe a dot on the apple of each cheek, then tap outward with fingertips. For lips, press on with a fingertip and blot. Layer for more intensity.

settings.detail: A cool, smooth balm that glides and then sets down.
Your own natural flush, from sheer to saturated.
Vegan, cruelty-free, gluten-free and made for all skin types.

settings.title: Dot on the apples
settings.text: One small dot per cheek is enough for a flush; go for two for more.

settings.label: Step two
settings.title: Tap outward
settings.text: Use warm fingertips to tap toward the temples. Patting melts the cream into skin.

settings.label: Step three
settings.title: Echo on the lips
settings.text: Press leftover color onto the lips and blot for a matching, tea-stained tint.

settings.heading: a five-step glow, start to finish

settings.title: Prep
settings.text: Press the glow serum in so cream color melts on instead of grabbing.

settings.title: Flush
settings.text: Add the blush stick to the apples and tap out.

settings.title: Shape
settings.text: Trace the lips with the pencil to set the outline.

settings.title: Tint
settings.text: Fill with a glossy stain in a shade that echoes your blush.

settings.title: Mist
